Senses.Explanation: Literally, ‘go wash your bowl.’ The command is the closing reply in Zhaozhou’s public case: a newly arrived monk requests instruction, Zhaozhou asks whether he has eaten his gruel, the monk says yes, and Zhaozhou tells him to wash his bowl; the record says that the monk suddenly awakened. The corpus preserves the line as the ‘Zhaozhou wash-the-bowl case,’ raises it in entering interviews, verses it, reuses it after other questions, and publicly disputes its reception. Dahui says that many places had raised and annotated the case, then restates ‘when the gruel is eaten, wash the bowl’ and asks whether any instruction was given. Another speaker reports washing his own bowl after gruel but not awakening and asks why. A later hall discourse calls the eaten gruel ‘adding a head atop a head’ and the command ‘drawing legs on a snake.’ Zen usage therefore bends an ordinary cleanup command into a stable public-case line, inseparable in the record from the preceding gruel question and from later examinations of the monk’s reported awakening.
Senses.Note: One corpus-wide sense. Quotation, reuse, verse, adverse appraisal, and the literal act all retain the same imperative; different readings of the case are not different things. This is the complete command, distinct from ‘wash the bowl’ (洗鉢盂) and from ‘bowl’ (鉢盂).

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問趙州。學人乍入叢林。乞師指示。州云。爾喫粥了也未。僧云。喫粥了。州云。洗鉢盂去。僧忽然大悟。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The complete named case and reported awakening.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。諸方拈掇甚多。下注脚亦不少。未曾有一人分明說破。妙喜今日為諸人分明說破。喫粥了便洗鉢盂。且道。還曾指示無。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dahui records broad circulation and annotation, restates the command, and asks whether it was instruction.

Occurrences.Kwic: 問如何是學人自己師云喫粥了也未云喫粥也師云洗鉢盂去
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The gruel question and bowl command are redeployed after a question about the student's own self.

Occurrences.Kwic: 大眾山僧今朝喫粥也洗鉢盂秪是不悟既是為善知識為什麼却不悟
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A speaker contrasts doing the same meal and washing acts with not awakening, then asks why.

Occurrences.Kwic: 祖舉趙州洗鉢盂話俾參。洎入室舉此話問師。爾道趙州向伊道甚麼。這僧便悟去。師曰。洗鉢盂去聻。祖曰。爾秖知路上事。不知路上滋味。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The record explicitly calls it Zhaozhou's wash-the-bowl case and uses it in an entering interview.

Occurrences.Kwic: 喫粥了也，頭上安頭。洗鉢盂去，為虵畫足。更問如何日納敗闕？
Occurrences.AttributionNote: A later hall discourse gives the received pair an adverse appraisal.
